Hockey starter: do goals predict points?

Data: the NHL's public web API (api-web.nhle.com) - live standings, no key needed. Credit the NHL when you use it. Standings give every team's points and goal differential. A first modeling question: how much of winning is just out-scoring opponents?

Top of the league right now: WPG (7 pts in 4 games).

Your turn

  • Who are this season's overachievers - points well above what their goals predict? Do they win tight games or lose blowouts?
  • Go deeper with MoneyPuck's free team data: shots, expected goals, and more.
  • Is home-ice advantage real? The API also serves every game's score.
